title: Annotatio III §.VIII Rescript: Assessors — Strimesius, Jablonski, Lütkens, Winkler
pass_a_gloss: joining to You for the present the following Assessors; namely Men Ours for sacred Sermons & Ordinary Professor of Sacred Theology in Our Frankfurt Academy, Samuel Strimesius, and Daniel Jablonski; and also Councillor of Our Consistory & Provost of Cölln, Francis Julius Lütkens, and also Archdeacon of the Magdeburg Basilica, Winkler.
pass_b_english: joining to You for now these Assessors:
Samuel Strimesius, Our man for sacred sermons and Ordinary Professor of Sacred Theology in Our Frankfurt Academy, and Daniel Jablonski;
also Francis Julius Lütkens, councillor of Our Consistory and Provost of Cölln; and Winkler, Archdeacon of the Magdeburg Basilica.
source_text: sequentes Tibi in praesentiarum Assessores adjungentes; nominatim Viros nobis à Concionibus sacris & SS. Theologiae in Academia Nostra Francofurtana Professorem Ordinarium, Samuelem Strimesium, & Danielem Jablonski; nec non Consistorii Nostri Consiliarium & Praepositum Coloniensem, Franciscum Julium Lütkens, nec non Basilicae Magdeburgicae Archidiaconum Winklerum.
notes: Four assessors named incl. Strimesius at Viadrina.
